```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(ggpubr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db) # Human annotation database
library(readxl)
source("ir_helpers.R")   # for make_ir_id()


metadata_sc5903_mw <- read_csv("metadata_sc5903_mw.csv")

## Velde et al. 2025
Velde_T025_vs_DMSO <- read_csv("results/ir/ERP171667/T025_vs_DMSO.csv")
Velde_T025_vs_DMSO <- Velde_T025_vs_DMSO |>
  mutate(
    "Hours" = 6,
    "Concentration" = "1uM",
    "Study" = "Velde"
  )

Velde_T025_vs_DMSO <- Velde_T025_vs_DMSO |> mutate(EnsemblID = str_extract(`...1`, "ENSG[0-9]+"),
         intron_id = `...1`,
    direction = case_when(
      log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "upregulated",
      log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "no change"
    )
  )

## Zhu et al. 2018 Data
CC671_3uM_vs_DMSO_6hr <- read_csv("results/ir/SRP141379/6hr/CC671_3uM_vs_DMSO.csv")
CC671_3uM_vs_DMSO_24hr <- read_csv("results/ir/SRP141379/24hr/CC671_3uM_vs_DMSO.csv")
CC671_10uM_vs_DMSO_6hr <- read_csv("results/ir/SRP141379/6hr/CC671_10uM_vs_DMSO.csv")
CC671_10uM_vs_DMSO_24hr <- read_csv("results/ir/SRP141379/24hr/CC671_10uM_vs_DMSO.csv")

CC671_3uM_vs_DMSO_6hr <- CC671_3uM_vs_DMSO_6hr|>
  mutate(
    "Hours" = 6,
    "Concentration" = "3uM",
    "Study" = "Zhu"
  )

CC671_3uM_vs_DMSO_24hr <- CC671_3uM_vs_DMSO_24hr |> mutate(
    "Hours" = 24,
    "Concentration" = "3uM",
    "Study" = "Zhu"
  )

CC671_10uM_vs_DMSO_6hr <- CC671_10uM_vs_DMSO_6hr |> mutate(
    "Hours" = 6,
    "Concentration" = "10uM",
    "Study" = "Zhu"
  )

CC671_10uM_vs_DMSO_24hr <- CC671_10uM_vs_DMSO_24hr|> mutate(
    "Hours" = 24,
    "Concentration" = "10uM",
    "Study" = "Zhu"
  )



srp_combined <- read_tsv(
  "results/ir/SRP141379_shah_filtered_combined.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

srp_combined <- srp_combined |>
  mutate(
    EnsemblID = str_extract(Name, "ENSG[0-9]+"),
    IntronID  = make_ir_id(pick(everything()))   # Name|Chr|Start|End|Strand
  )

# ---- distinct introns per gene ---------------------------------------------
srp_combined |>
  distinct(EnsemblID, IntronID) |>
  count(EnsemblID, name = "n_distinct_introns") |>
  arrange(desc(n_distinct_introns))

#Quality control data
srp_combined <- srp_combined |> 
  mutate(EnsemblID = str_extract(`Name`, "ENSG[0-9]+"))
#sanity check
dim(srp_combined)
head(srp_combined)

erp_combined <- read_tsv(
  "results/ir/ERP171667_shah_filtered_combined.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE)

erp_combined <- erp_combined |>
  mutate(
    EnsemblID = str_extract(Name, "ENSG[0-9]+"),
    IntronID  = make_ir_id(pick(everything()))   # Name|Chr|Start|End|Strand
  )
#sanity check
dim(erp_combined)
head(erp_combined)

# Delta IR
delta_erp <- read_tsv(
  "results/ir/ERP171667_delta_ir.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

delta_erp <- delta_erp |> mutate(
    EnsemblID = str_extract(IntronID, "ENSG[0-9]+"))

delta_erp_filter <- delta_erp |> filter(delta_mean_ir_ratio_T025_vs_DMSO != "NA") #4917 introns present in both groups

delta_ir_srp_zhu <- read_tsv(
  "results/ir/SRP141379_delta_ir.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


delta_ir_srp_iwai <- read_tsv(
  "results/ir/SRP112607_delta_ir.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```
